blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — If the statements from Vice President Sara Duterte’s spokesperson Paolo Panelo against the Senate Impeachment Court is meant to seek the spotlight, Manila Rep. Joel Chua has no qualms about giving it. Chua, a member of the prosecution team for Duterte’s impeachment trial, said this in a press briefing on Friday after being asked about Panelo’s alleged attacks against the impeachment court. Panelo was earlier reacting to the court’s having allowed a lower minimum vote to sustain a conviction if some senator-judges are absent.
